title: Koi-Koi (Hanafuda)
description: Hanafuda card matching game. Score Yaku points for bankroll payouts.
htmlLayout: Match cards to score Yaku points!

actionHandlers.play: if (state.points < 100) return alert('Need 100 points'); state.points -= 100; const score = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4); const win = score * 50; state.points += win; document.getElementById('kk-info').innerText = 'Scored ' + score + ' Yaku points! Earned ' + win + ' pts.'; updatePointsDisplay();
